context: Mei and Aoi chat about moving to the city.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: urban-life chat; city vocabulary (区/住宅/都市/センター) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 来月、都市の方へ引っ越すの。
lines.en: I'm moving toward the city next month.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle relaxed delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Oh, which ward will you live in?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm curious cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 駅の東側の区を、考えてるの。
lines.en: I'm thinking of the ward east of the station.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm thoughtful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そっちは、住宅が多い地域だよね。
lines.en: That area has a lot of housing, right?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、新しい住宅が増えてるみたい。
lines.en: Yeah, new housing seems to be increasing.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 近くに、文化センターもあるよ。
lines.en: There's a cultural center nearby too.
lines.style: helpful barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: センターが近いと、便利でいいな。
lines.en: A nearby center would be convenient.
lines.style: pleased woman voice, soft warm delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 都市の生活、楽しみだね!
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm bubbly delivery throughout
